offering_description.value: Distributes propane and related products and services to homes, farms and businesses across the US. Delivers fuel by bulk truck and cylinder exchange, and installs and services gas appliances and tanks.

primary_services.value: propane delivery; appliance installation and repair; tank rental and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2C: homeowners using propane for heating, cooking and water heating; B2B: farms, restaurants, commercial and industrial businesses, propane resellers

revenue_model.value: product sales: propane, propane cylinders and appliances sold to customers; service fees: appliance installation, repair and maintenance services; rental or leasing: tanks rented to customers for propane storage
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys propane from refiners and pipelines and sells it to end users; retailer: sells cylinders and appliances through retail locations to households; service provider: installs and services appliances and tanks for residential and business customers

geography_served.value: US national: many US states across the country

specialization.value: related lines: propane sales, cylinders, gas appliances and services sharing customers and delivery network

distribution_channels.value: own locations: branch locations and service centers across its territories; direct sales: bulk propane delivered by route trucks to customer tanks; third-party retail: cylinder exchange through retail stores and gas stations; online: online ordering and account management for customers
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: propane storage and transport safety rules (DOT, PHMSA), EPA environmental rules and OSHA workplace safety
